## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation
- [ ] No private key, seed phrase, credential, local artifact, or `.env` file is included

## Contract and deployment safety

- [ ] Contract behavior is unchanged, or contract changes are explicitly identified and reviewed
- [ ] The deployed contract address was not changed unintentionally
- [ ] No deployment or blockchain write is part of this pull request

## QA evidence

List automated results and any manual browser or funded-wallet checks. Mark unperformed checks as unverified.
